snippet.title: Quacolé Tennis Demo available - Play for free NOW! 🎾🤝🎾
snippet.description:
Quacolé Tennis demo is available for you to play now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3420640/Quacol_Tennis_Demo/

Overcome all the challenges in the Single Player campaign or invite a friend to win all the matches in the Co-op campaign together. Play multiplayer locally or via Steam Remote Play.

And don't forget to add Quacolé Tennis to your Steam wishlist to stay up to date with upcoming updates!
